name: Franz Wagner
lede: Four straight 30-point games: 34.0 a night on 53 percent shooting with 7.8 assists, and the Magic won three of the four.

move.title: The Euro step
move.text: He picks the ball up high on the drive, takes one long stride to one side so the help defender commits, then steps back across and finishes around him, often with a soft floater. As Monty Williams put it when he coached the Pistons: he “euro-steps around the help.”
steps: Picks the ball up high with both hands, still at full speed.
One long stride to one side. The help defender slides over.
A second long stride back across, around him, and a soft floater.
